name: Log line classification
description: Judge one log line in the context of its neighbors.

state.line: 2026-09-19T08:14:02Z WARN  payments.refund: refund failed for order 88213 customer=jane.doe@example.com amount=49.00 reason=card_expired; will retry in 1h
context: 2026-09-19T08:14:00Z INFO  payments.refund: refund ok order=88209 amount=12.50
2026-09-19T08:14:01Z INFO  payments.refund: refund ok order=88211 amount=8.00
2026-09-19T08:14:03Z INFO  payments.refund: refund ok order=88215 amount=120.00
2026-09-19T08:14:05Z INFO  payments.refund: batch 4411 done: 11 ok, 1 failed

log_level_should_be.instructions: Judging only `line` (use `context` for background), what log level should this message have been emitted at?

criteria.DEBUG: Diagnostic detail useful only when investigating.
criteria.WARN: Something unexpected but handled; no immediate action required.
criteria.ERROR: An operation failed and will not self-heal; someone should look.

contains_pii.instructions: Does `line` contain personally identifiable information that should not appear in logs?

criteria.false: Only opaque ids (order numbers, customer ids as integers/UUIDs), amounts, and technical fields.

actionable.instructions: Does `line` describe something a human needs to act on, as opposed to something the system will handle by itself?
